mentions.name: Taipei Parking
mentions.description: A parking spot finder for Taipei and New Taipei, available as an Android app and a web app, that helps users locate available parking spots. It offers an English-language alternative to existing Mandarin-only parking apps.
mentions.problem: Finding an available parking spot, especially during weekends, is very difficult, and existing apps are only in Mandarin.
mentions.audience: People in the Taipei and New Taipei area looking for parking
mentions.source_excerpt: The last couple weeks have been working on a parking spot app for Taipei and New Taipei. Finding a available spot, especially during weekends is very difficult. There are some apps, but only in Mandarin, so I did a English version.
